1934, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Sister Leanides .. Dom. - Organic heart.
Page 265 Nov. 11 Page 266 Nov. 12 Loyd Walker - 16 - no religion but kindly disposed, threatened with total blindness by explosion in little laboratory at home. Doctors had no hope of ever seeing again. - you were asked on Oct. 31 - 2 weeks To-day to pray for him and that day after being enrolled in Ser. Masses .. . Now they wonder that both eyes will be saved. - pray on. He is to have another operation to-morrow - enrolled again.
Wm. Hanson - 78 - "creeping paralysis" fell and broke sholder in a spell ....
Mrs. M. Colombo - 69 - pneumonia
Ant. Sales - 42 - in bad company no active interest in home. Wife asks prayers for improvement .....
Jerry S. Butaille - 41 - ought to Catholic - nothing ... . beautiful family .... prayers - Enrolled To-day .. "black book" past "golden ... beginning ....
Blank Page
Page 267 Page 268 Nov. 13 Henry Elton - 52 0 of Toronto - heart trouble - very serious - recent convert.
John Coneff - 38 - and Fam.
Rosary Academy ..... Bay City
Aliqua - victima about 18 in sad need employ - stares as "vacua"
Hazel Wellwood - 17 - see Oct. 18 improving right along.
Mrs. Kliemann - 73 - widow, beaten out of lawful rent - tenants moved out in anger - 17 old son smashes big window - Allhowleen" trick.
15 Ed. McQuillan - 13 - Threatened with another major operation on lungs; has had one already and at least fifteen minors during last 8 yrs. Boy inhaled timothy - hay-seed. Some of it remained in lungs causing ulcers like T.B. Enrolled To-day N.B. - Feb. 19 - '35 - Boy's father reports no operation further necessary. Boy improving O.K.
